snaps.title: Create / Edit PR
snaps.sub: Stage 01 · existing ERP module — outside this prototype
snaps.crumbs: Command Center / Create / Edit PR
snaps.body:
Existing ERP moduleMarketing and Store raise product requisitions in the existing ERP screen. Submitted requisitions arrive in this module as requisition lines.
This module sends
Submitted PR lines → Requisition Board
It sends back
Purchase requisition with item, qty, required date, reason and attachment
Hand-off queue20 requisition lines in the working case
Integration points are TBD (Open Policy Item 12).
